setup.heading: Set a passphrase
setup.intro: Your data is encrypted with this passphrase. Forget it and there is no recovery — there is no cloud and no reset.

timeline.heading: Timeline
timeline.noEntries: No entries yet. Click "New entry" to start.

llm.title: AI models (Ollama)
llm.intro: AI features run entirely on your machine through Ollama. Pull the models below and they will be used to extract entities and build the graph in the background.
llm.ollamaDown: Ollama not reachable. Install from ollama.com, then start it. The app will retry automatically.

graph.title: Graph
graph.empty: No entities yet — write a few entries and the graph will populate as they are processed.

nav.hypothesesHint: AI-noticed patterns the engine wants you to discuss with a clinician

safety.banner: This software helps you organise patient-reported context. It is NOT a diagnosis. Discuss findings with a licensed clinician.

hypotheses.heading: AI-noticed patterns
hypotheses.disclaimerHeading: These are pattern observations, not diagnoses.
hypotheses.disclaimerBody: The engine compares your journal against curated profiles of common and rare conditions. Each card cites the entries and lab values that contributed. Bring the cited journal entries to a clinician — they decide whether further evaluation is warranted.
hypotheses.empty: No patterns to show yet. Add a few entries (or load a demo patient from the Timeline) and re-check.

insights.heading: Clinician brief
insights.disclaimer: This brief is patient-reported context for clinical evaluation. Every assertion in it cites the underlying journal entry. It is not a diagnosis.

demo.tooltip: Replace journal contents with a curated synthetic patient for demo or evaluation
demo.heading: Curated synthetic patients
demo.warnOverwrite: Selecting a persona will replace your current entries.

documents.heading: Medical documents
documents.empty: No documents yet. Attach a visit note or lab from any entry to populate this view.
documents.disclaimer: AI extracted these fields from a photo of the document. Verify before treating any value as authoritative — this is not a diagnosis.

labs.heading: Lab timeline
labs.empty: No lab values recorded yet. Attach a lab result document to populate this view.
labs.pickPrompt: Pick a test on the left to see its history.

medications.heading: Medications
medications.empty: No medications recorded yet. Attach a prescription or visit note to populate this view.
